bio.zh-CN: 科幻作家，代表作為《三體》三部曲。《三體》獲 2015 年雨果獎最佳長篇小說獎，《死神永生》獲 2017 年軌跡獎。
bio.en: Science fiction writer best known for the Three-Body trilogy. The Three-Body Problem won the 2015 Hugo Award for Best Novel, and Death’s End received the 2017 Locus Award.

bio.zh-CN: 科幻作家，以《沙丘》系列聞名。《沙丘》於 1965 年出版，後續作品包括《沙丘救世主》和《沙丘之子》。
bio.en: Science fiction writer best known for the Dune saga. Dune was published in 1965, followed by novels including Dune Messiah and Children of Dune.

bio.zh-CN: 科幻與科普作家，代表作包括基地、機器人和銀河帝國系列。他的創作橫跨科學、歷史等多個領域。
bio.en: Writer of science fiction and nonfiction, known for the Foundation, Robot and Galactic Empire series. His books also covered science, history and other subjects.

authors.directory: 004 - Jules Gabriel Verne(儒勒·加布裡埃爾·凡爾納)
authors.name: 儒勒·凡爾納

bio.zh-CN: 法國作家，代表作包括《海底兩萬裡》《地心遊記》和《八十天環遊地球》。他的小說常把科學設想與探險故事結合。
bio.en: French novelist whose works include Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea, Journey to the Centre of the Earth and Around the World in Eighty Days. His novels combine scientific imagination with adventure.

bio.zh-CN: 作家，1797 年生於倫敦。《弗蘭肯斯坦》於 1818 年出版；她還創作了《最後一個人》等小說，並撰寫傳記、散文與遊記。
bio.en: Novelist born in London in 1797. Frankenstein was published in 1818; her other writing includes The Last Man, biographical essays and travel writing.

authors.directory: 006 - Ray Douglas Bradbury(雷·道格拉斯·布拉德伯裡)
authors.name: 雷·布拉德伯裡

bio.zh-CN: 作家，代表作包括《華氏451度》《火星紀事》和《圖案人》。除了長短篇小說，他也為電影、電視和劇場創作。
bio.en: Writer whose books include Fahrenheit 451, The Martian Chronicles and The Illustrated Man. He also wrote for film, television and the theatre.

authors.directory: 007 - Orson Scott Card(奧森·斯科特·卡德)
authors.name: 奧森·斯科特·卡德

bio.zh-CN: 科幻作家，以《安德的遊戲》及其系列作品聞名。相關作品還包括延續安德故事的《死者代言人》和影子系列。
bio.en: Science fiction writer known for Ender’s Game and the wider Ender Universe, including Speaker for the Dead and the Shadow series.

bio.zh-CN: 科幻作家，以中短篇創作見長。作品集包括《你一生的故事》和《呼吸》，曾獲得多項科幻文學獎。
bio.en: Award-winning science fiction writer whose collections include Stories of Your Life and Others and Exhalation. His work focuses on short fiction.

bio.zh-CN: 科幻與奇幻作家，作品曾獲雨果獎、星雲獎、西奧多·斯特金紀念獎和世界奇幻獎。
bio.en: Writer of science fiction and fantasy whose work has received the Hugo, Nebula, Theodore Sturgeon and World Fantasy Awards.

bio.zh-CN: 中國科幻作家、工程師，1993 年以《亞當迴歸》進入科幻創作。代表作包括《生命之歌》《七重外殼》《類人》和《蟻生》。
bio.en: Chinese science fiction writer and engineer who began publishing in 1993. His debut received a Galaxy Award; his work includes novels and short fiction.

bio.zh-CN: 科幻作家，曾從事軟體工程工作。代表作包括《火星救援》《月球城市》和《挽救計劃》。
bio.en: Science fiction writer and former software engineer whose novels include The Martian, Artemis and Project Hail Mary.

authors.directory: 012 - Arthur Charles Clarke(亞瑟·查理斯·克拉克)
authors.name: 亞瑟·克拉克

bio.zh-CN: 科幻與科學寫作作者，代表作包括《童年的終結》《2001：太空漫遊》和《與拉瑪相會》。他的寫作生涯持續了六十餘年。
bio.en: Writer of science fiction and science fact whose novels include Childhood’s End, 2001: A Space Odyssey and Rendezvous with Rama. His writing career spanned more than six decades.

authors.directory: 013 - Arthur Conan Doyle(亞瑟·柯南·道爾)
authors.name: 亞瑟·柯南·道爾

bio.zh-CN: 英國作家，創作了福爾摩斯偵探故事和以查林傑教授為主角的科幻冒險作品。
bio.en: British author of the Sherlock Holmes stories and the Professor Challenger adventures.

sources.label: Arthur Conan Doyle Encyclopedia: The Lost World publication and original text

authors.directory: 014 - Herbert George Wells(赫伯特·喬治·威爾斯)
authors.name: 赫伯特·喬治·威爾斯

bio.zh-CN: 英國作家，代表作包括《時間機器》《世界大戰》和《隱身人》，以科學設想探討未來社會與人類處境。
bio.en: British author whose scientific romances include The Time Machine, The War of the Worlds, and The Invisible Man.

sources.label: Project Gutenberg: H. G. Wells and original English works

authors.directory: 015 - Olaf Stapledon(奧拉夫·斯塔普爾頓)
authors.name: 奧拉夫·斯塔普爾頓

bio.zh-CN: 英國哲學家與科幻作家，《最後與最初的人》和《造星主》以漫長時間尺度描寫人類、文明與宇宙的演化。
bio.en: British philosopher and science fiction author of Last and First Men and Star Maker, exploring humanity and civilization across vast spans of time.

sources.label: Project Gutenberg: Last and First Men
頭像：利物浦大學檔案館

bio.zh-CN: 美國科幻作家，作品常透過機器、替身和不穩定的現實，追問身份、記憶與人的處境。
bio.en: American science fiction author whose stories explore identity, artificial beings, memory, and unstable realities.

sources.label: Philip K. Dick bibliography: Second Variety

bio.zh-CN: 美國科幻作家，著有《海中山》。
bio.en: American science fiction author of The Mountain in the Sea.

sources.label: Macmillan: The Mountain in the Sea
